encounter.text: An ancient rat sits wrapped in layers of faded silk, eyes obscured by a blindfold of woven hair. She has arranged twelve finger-bones on the ground in front of her in a pattern that almost makes sense. 'Ah,' she says, before you've made a sound. 'A warm one. Uncertain of outcome. You may sit.'

choices.text: Demand a straight answer, no theatre.

reading.text: She speaks for a long time. You understand perhaps a third of it. The words don't add up to meaning — but something about the cadence settles your breathing, unknots your shoulders. You feel, obscurely, better prepared. She says nothing when you rise to leave.

angered.text: 'Straight answers,' she says, 'are for those who can bear them.' She rises — faster than she should — and the finger-bones scatter. 'You asked.'

items.name: Bone Scatter
items.description: Hurls the reading bones with unerring aim.
